text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I need to make up my mind soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The message that arrived on my smartphone was from <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems they're planning to
"hold voluntary training among the members."
After checking the details, I give them my approval.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the first "Representative Exchange Match,"
a bond among comrades began to blossom—not only between the Trainers, but between the Umamusume as well.
choice_data_list: —We're going to aim for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe together.
—Together, we're aiming for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The wall we must overcome is high. That is precisely why everyone must work together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: [Sender: Satake Mei]

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "Sorry to interrupt when you're busy. There is something I need to tell you all once again."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "After the second Representative Exchange Race, I will select four of you to represent Japan."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...These four are the ones running in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Only four people?
Out of all of us...?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You were prepared for this, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: "The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is the pinnacle of racing. It's not just Japan—contenders from all over the world are aiming for the top."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Squeezing into the starting lineup ain't easy either.
We should focus on quality over quantity.
choice_data_list: ...That's why we're entering an Uma Musume who can win.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
B-But! Even without narrowing it down to just the elite,
until race registration, everyone here could—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's no way an Umamusume who wasn't chosen here
could ever take the title of number one in the world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...We ain't going there
just to make memories.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if we cooperate as a team,
it's so that we can become stronger ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if you've grown attached to them,
don't bring that into the race.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me, Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"The announcement is scheduled immediately following
the conclusion of Race 2 of the Representative Exchange Matches."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Even if someone isn't chosen as a representative, I will arrange it so that anyone who wishes can accompany us to France.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, when selecting Japan's "representatives,"
we plan to take into account their running up through the exchange meet itself.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I want you to pour all your strength into it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Dozens of Umamusume
are participating in 'Project L'Arc.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They are <chrname>'s companions.
Sharing the same ambition, dividing joys and sorrows,
and continuing to hone each other going forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, only four representatives will be chosen for Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how deep the bond becomes.
No matter how well one understands the other's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if you've grown attached to them,
don't bring that into the race.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—Now this is turning into
a truly thrilling turn of events!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Competing against one another are comrades who share the same dream.
Who will be among the chosen four—?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Guh, how brutal...!
If I were a reader, I'd be so on edge wanting to know what happens next that I wouldn't be able to sleep!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki... She too is a member of
Project L'Arc, striving to take on
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I swear!
I will be chosen as a representative! Because—”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is calling to me...
To create the greatest masterpiece ever!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! European racecourses are tough tracks
that demand immense power and stamina.
They're so grueling that half-hearted ability won't cut it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still—if I can sprint through a downpour
on a heavy track, I know I can create
some blazing drama!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A steep uphill slope, combined with heavy European turf that tangles around the legs.
Stamina is drained, leaving no room to breathe—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: However! Kiseki refuses to give up! Maintaining the lead as they head into the final corner!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Europe's finest close in, but what incredible
tenacity from Kiseki! And then... and then—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, without a doubt!
This 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe' will go down as a masterpiece in history!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So even if earning a spot as representative is a long shot,
I'm gonna pry that door wide open!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wonderful!
...Hehe, to tell you the truth, I've had my eye on you two for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A promising new star beginning to make her mark!
She's sure to achieve remarkable feats from here on—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And that's what makes competing so worthwhile!
No hard feelings, no matter who wins, okay?!
